name: micro-frontend-demo
description: KISS Micro Frontend demo with Module Federation, shared state & EventBus

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix host && npm install --prefix remote-header && npm install --prefix remote-products && npm install --prefix remote-cart && npm install --prefix remote-user
scripts.start:all: concurrently -n host,header,products,cart,user -c auto "npm run start:host" "npm run start:header" "npm run start:products" "npm run start:cart" "npm run start:user"
